text.content: The R7 formal run showed finite optimizer progress and retained the initial aligned-memory advantage, but independent telemetry averaged only about 60%-65% GPU utilization and 54-56 GiB memory per 183359 MiB B200. Preserve and cancel that run as a separate low-utilization record before its first checkpoint, then benchmark activation-checkpointing none with larger per-rank batches from the same R4 model-only warm start. Select by steady-state samples/s, finite gradients, memory below 90%, and the same aligned versus zero/shuffle intervention gate. Launch a new, independently named 20,000-step confirmatory run only after the probe passes; do not resume R7 optimizer, scheduler, trainer, or data-stream state.
